title: Support Chatbot → RAG over Docs → Cited Answer

sections.label: 1 · CONVERSATION
sections.note: Chat arrives from the website widget. Session memory keeps the last ten turns so follow-up questions like "what about the enterprise plan?" resolve against what was already asked.

sections.label: 2 · RETRIEVE & ANSWER
sections.note: The agent searches the vector index for the passages that actually answer the question, then writes a reply grounded only in what it retrieved. Every claim carries the source document it came from.

sections.label: 3 · CONFIDENCE GATE
sections.note: If retrieval returns nothing close enough, the bot does not improvise. Low-confidence questions hand off to a human instead of inventing an answer — the failure mode that erodes trust fastest.

sections.label: 4 · RESPOND & LOG
sections.note: The answer goes back to the widget, and every exchange is logged with its retrieved sources and confidence so you can see exactly what the bot has been telling customers.

input_sample.message: Does the Professional plan let me export matter records to our own S3 bucket, or is that enterprise only?

output_sample.answer: Yes — scheduled exports to your own S3 bucket are included on Professional. You'll configure the bucket and IAM role under Settings → Data Export, and exports can run nightly or weekly. The Enterprise-only piece is bring-your-own-KMS key for encryption at rest.
